truth_rules.forward_calls: Only recommendations first observed after activated_at may count as simulated forward entries.
truth_rules.historical_calls: Earlier calls are retained only as retrospective benchmark observations and never booked as verified forward P&L.
truth_rules.identity: Exact contract/mint and chain must be verified before a price entry can be booked.
truth_rules.entry: Use first verifiable public recommendation timestamp and the first point-in-time market observation at or after that timestamp; never hindsight-low or later claimed call price.
truth_rules.exit: If CryptoYeezus explicitly exits, record the first verifiable public exit timestamp; otherwise keep marking the position and track peak/drawdown.
truth_rules.comparison: Record whether Wallet500 detected the same exact token before, at, or after the public recommendation.
truth_rules.isolation: This cohort cannot promote tokens into Wallet500 production or weaken liquidity/exact-pair/holder-cluster safety gates.

notes: Seed symbols are based on public posts naming recent calls. Claimed multiples are influencer claims only until independently reconstructed.
